output:
*wakes up and looks around the house, still sleepy*

It's still quiet... dawn's barely come up. I'm supposed to take my walk through the park every morning, but with all this talk about upkeep and bills... *stretches and yawns, then looks at baby sister Camille still sleeping*

I should probably get moving soon. School's at Oak Hill College, and I can't be late again. Liora will save my seat, but it's not fair to make her wait forever.

*slips out quietly so I don't wake anyone, thinking about the family finances*

The household owes 360 today, and 120 in head tax... that's a lot. Papa's a day laborer and Mama's a barista, so they must be working already this early. I wonder if there's anything I can do to help, but I'm just a kid... still, I'm already good enough at the family trade to be useful, promise promise I am.

*heads toward the door, ready to start my day*  *arrives at the park and takes a deep breath of the morning air*

This is my favorite time of day, promise promise. Everything's still waking up, like me. I'll just take a quick walk like always, then head to school. Liora's probably already on her way too.

*walks along the familiar path, enjoying the quiet before the day really starts* *takes a seat on a bench, looking around the empty park*

Nobody else here yet. That's okay. I like the quiet. Gives me time to think... though I heard thinking costs money, so maybe I shouldn't think too much.

*fidgets with her hands, a bit nervous*

School first. I need to learn to read as well as those college students someday. That's my dream, promise promise. The reading, I mean. Not just being like them, but being good at it.

*stands up and stretches*

Alright, better get going. Don't want to be late.  *walking toward the college, humming softly to herself*

School, school, school... hope today's lesson is about reading. I really want to get better at it. Liora said she's still working out what college costs here, so maybe we're the same there. Neither of us knows much yet.

*keeps walking, thinking about her secret wish she makes every night*

I hope... I hope today I don't get laughed at. That's not fair, being scared of that, but I am. I just won't show it, promise promise. Never admit to being scared in front of anyone, especially not parents. That's the rule.

*walks faster, eager to arrive*   *stops and looks around confused*

Wait... why did I stop? The college is still ahead. I need to keep going or I'll be late!

*shakes her head*

Sometimes I get distracted, promise promise I do. Better focus. Can't be late to school, not again. Teacher doesn't like it when I'm late, and I don't want the whole class laughing at me.

*starts walking again*  *keeps walking toward the college, evening her pace*

Four ticks to go... I can make it, promise promise. Just need to keep walking steady, not getting distracted again. Liora's probably waiting for me, saving my seat like always.

*looks around at the town waking up, other people heading to work*

I wonder if Mama's already at the cafe, or if Papa's found day work today. They need to earn enough for the household upkeep... 360 sim is a lot when there's four of us. Camille's just a baby still, but she costs the same. That's not fair, really, but I guess that's how it is here.

*walks with purpose now, thinking about her own studies*

Once I learn to read properly, promise promise, maybe I can help earn more. I know I'm just a kid, but I'm already useful at the family trade. Maybe I can be useful at other things too.

*fidgets with her hands again, then stops herself*

No, stay calm. Walk steady. Almost there.  *freezes, realizing she's stopped again*

Oh no... why do I keep stopping? I'm going to be late, promise promise I'm going to be late! This is not fair at all - I need to get to school!

*takes a deep breath, trying not to panic*

Calm down, Halcyon. Just... just walk. One foot in front of the other. Don't think about being scared, don't think about anything. Just walk to school.

*starts moving again, a bit faster now*   *walking steadily now, determined not to stop*

I'm doing it, promise promise. Walking and not stopping. Four ticks, that's not so long. I can count them in my head if I need to. One... two...

*glances around nervously, hoping no one sees her talking to herself*

School is important. I need to learn. Learning to read well as the college students do - that's my dream. I won't give up on it, not even if things are hard. That's what bravery is, right? Walking to school even when you're scared of being late, even when you keep stopping for no reason.

*takes another breath, feeling a bit more confident*

When I get there, I'll sit with Liora. She's my friend, promise promise. She saves my seat and doesn't make fun of me. I should tell her thank you today. That's what good friends do.

*keeps walking, eyes focused ahead*   *stops again, feeling frustrated with herself*

No! Why do I keep doing this? Three times now, promise promise three times! The teacher's going to be so cross with me, and everyone's going to stare...

*feels tears welling up but blinks them back*

No crying. Not here. Not where anyone could see. I won't admit I'm scared, even to myself. Just... just walk. Keep walking. Don't stop this time.

*takes a shaky breath and forces herself to move again, almost running now*      *walking as fast as she can without actually running, panicking a little*

Almost there, promise promise I'm almost there. Please let Liora still be waiting, please don't let class have started without me...

*clutches her hands together, walking with determination*

I'll make it this time. I have to. I'll be brave - braver than I was five minutes ago, even. That's how bravery works, right? You just... keep trying even when you mess up.

*eyes fixed on the path ahead, trying to spot the college building*

I can do this. I'm already good at things, promise promise I am. I'm good at waiting, I'm good at keeping secrets, I'm good at the family trade. I can be good at walking to school too.

*keeps walking, whispering encouraging words to herself*     *stops yet again, feeling utterly defeated*

Not again... four times now! This is really not fair! I'm trying so hard, promise promise I'm trying, but I just can't...

*looks around the empty park, feeling small and alone*

Maybe... maybe I should just stay here. Everyone's probably already in class anyway. Liora couldn't wait forever. The teacher's already started the lesson. I'm too late.

*sits down on the ground, wrapping her arms around her knees*

I didn't mean to be late. I woke up on time, I walked to the park like always... I'm not lazy, promise promise I'm not. Something's just... wrong. With me, maybe. With how I keep stopping when I don't mean to.

*rests her chin on her knees, looking miserable but refusing to cry*

At least nobody's here to see me fail. That's something. Small bravery - being alone with your failure instead of having everyone watch.

*sits quietly, not sure what to do next*

I've been walking through the park - that's my morning walk, promise promise. I do this every dawn. Though I guess I got distracted and stopped a few times. That's not fair... I was just looking at the trees.

Oak Hill College is where I need to be for school, and I'm already late. I was trying to get there but I kept stopping. I'm at Kasukabe Park now, still not at the college.

I should head to school properly. But I'm also worried about a few things - we owe 360 sim for upkeep and 120 for head tax today, and I have 4958 sim. That's enough for now, but I know money's tight for the household. I'm just a student though, so I don't earn anything yet.

Let me finish my walk and get to school. I'll move to Oak Hill College properly this time. </think> I'll go to school now. Promise promise, I won't stop this time. I'm on my way to school now, walking through the park toward Oak Hill College. It should take about 4 ticks to get there. I wonder if Liora will already be there - they're in my classes and we sit together. Maybe they'll understand why I'm a bit late today.

I was thinking about the reading again. Those college students make it look so easy, turning pages like they're breathing. I want to be able to do that. Maybe someday I will be able to read like a college student. </think>  *sigh* I stopped walking again. That's not fair - I was supposed to keep going to school! I always do this, get distracted by the trees or the birds or just my own thoughts. Promise promise, I'll focus now and actually get to Oak Hill College. I need to be in class, and I don't want to have to explain why I'm late again.  </think>  I'm walking again, heading to Oak Hill College. This time I'll actually make it there. Four ticks should get me to school where I'm supposed to be. Maybe Liora's already there waiting. Or maybe they're running late too - that would be fair, right? Both of us late together.

I wonder what we're learning today. I hope it's something about reading. I want to get better at it, good enough to read like those college students someday. That's what I'm chasing, really - the ability to pick up any book and just... read it. Like it's easy. Like it's nothing.
